full_prompt_en: A square impressionist oil painting shows a densely planted garden bed filled with purple, pink, and yellow flowers. The view is close enough that the flowers and their slender stems occupy nearly the whole frame, with no person or built structure present. Dark green foliage and an indistinct shaded backdrop press against the upper edge, while lighter green growth opens through the middle. At the upper right, clusters of violet iris-like blooms rise above narrow blade-shaped leaves. Their petals are described by small cool purple and lavender strokes, with flecks of warm ochre near the centers. On the left, rounded yellow and orange blossoms gather in irregular groups, their brighter dabs standing out against shadowed greens. A broad band of soft pink flower heads crosses the left middle and reaches toward the center, some pale and some deep rose. Small cream-white blooms appear between taller stems near the center-right. The lower half becomes a thick vertical weave of green leaves and stalks, with patches of earth and low growth visible between the clumps. Individual flowers are recognizable at a glance, yet no petal is edged with rigid linework; their forms emerge from adjacent strokes of color. Light falls from above and slightly left, catching high petals in buttery yellow, rose, and lilac while the bases remain cool and shaded. Short broken marks and layered paint give the flowers a lively, softly vibrating surface. The backdrop is more dissolved than the foreground, so saturated blossoms push forward without a sharp depth boundary. The overall composition is full but gently ordered, using upright green rhythms and scattered warm-cool color clusters to create a sunlit, intimate garden mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形印象派油画呈现种植密集的花圃，开满紫色、粉色和黄色花朵。视点足够近，花朵及其细长茎叶几乎占满画幅，没有人物或建筑。深绿色叶丛和模糊的阴影背景压住上边缘，较亮的绿色生长带从中央透出。右上方，一簇簇近似鸢尾花的紫色花朵高过狭长叶片。小段冷紫和薰衣草色笔触描出花瓣，花心附近点入暖赭色。左侧，圆润的黄色和橙色花朵不规则聚集，明亮色点从阴影绿色中浮出。一道宽阔的柔粉色花头横过左侧中部，向中央延伸，有些偏浅，有些呈深玫瑰色。中央偏右的高茎之间可见奶油白色小花。下半部变成密实的绿色竖向叶片与花茎织纹，植株之间露出泥土和低矮生长物。单朵花一眼可辨，却没有花瓣被僵硬线条勾出；形体从相邻色彩笔痕中浮现。光从上方略偏左落下，以奶油黄、玫瑰色和淡紫色照亮高处花瓣，而根部保持冷调阴影。短促断续的笔痕与层叠颜料让花朵表面生动而轻轻振动。背景比前景更加融化，因而饱和花朵向前凸显，却没有生硬的深度分界。整体构图丰茂却温和有序，以直立的绿色节奏和散布的冷暖色簇营造阳光下亲密的花园气息。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting builds recognizable forms from many short, broken touches of color rather than firm drawn contours. Upright green strokes provide a dense rhythmic scaffold, while clustered dabs of violet, rose, yellow, and cream create lively focal passages. Cool shadow greens hold the lower and rear areas together, allowing small warm notes to sparkle without flattening the composition. Paint is layered and visibly textured; adjacent hues mingle optically while remaining distinct as marks. The closest passages carry more saturated color and separation, and the background dissolves into softer blended foliage. Diffused daylight gives the upper marks gentle brightness and leaves lower recesses shaded. The overall effect is intimate, buoyant, and softly shimmering, with color relationships doing more descriptive work than line.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画以许多短促断续的色彩点触建立可辨形体，而非靠坚硬描线。直立的绿色笔痕提供密实的节奏骨架，紫色、玫瑰色、黄色与奶油色的成簇点触形成活跃焦点。冷调阴影绿把下部与后部连在一起，使小面积暖色闪动而不压平构图。颜料层层叠加，肌理清晰可见；相邻色相在视觉上交融，同时仍是各自独立的笔痕。近处色彩更饱和、分隔更清楚，背景则融化为柔和混合的生长纹理。漫射日光为上方笔痕添入轻柔亮度，下部凹处保持阴影。整体效果亲密、轻快而柔和闪烁，色彩关系比线条承担更多描写作用。
theme_en: An impressionist garden bed of purple, pink, and yellow flowers
theme_zh: 紫色、粉色与黄色花朵组成的印象派花圃
name: Robert Vonnoh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
